title: Introduction to the mtarm Package
text: mtarm package provides computational tool designed Bayesian estimation, inference, forecasting multivariate Threshold Autoregressive (TAR) models. models provide versatile approach modeling nonlinear multivariate time series include multivariate Self-Exciting Threshold Autoregressive (SETAR) Vector Autoregressive (VAR) models particular cases (Vanegas, Calderón V, Rondón 2025). package accommodates broad class innovation distributions beyond Gaussian assumption, Student-tt, slash, symmetric hyperbolic, Laplace, contaminated normal, skew-normal, skew-tt distributions, thereby enabling robust modeling heavy tails, asymmetry, non-Gaussian characteristics.

text: mtarm R package Bayesian estimation, inference, model comparison, forecasting multivariate Threshold Autoregressive (TAR) models. package supports multiple innovation distributions, automatic variable selection Stochastic Search Variable Selection (SSVS), standard forecasting rolling-origin forecast evaluation. package accommodates multivariate TAR models exogenous variables allows flexible error specifications, including Gaussian, Student-tt, skew-normal, skew-Student-tt, Laplace, slash, contaminated normal, symmetric hyperbolic distributions.

title: Bayesian Estimation of Multivariate Threshold Autoregressive Models
text: Bayesian estimation model parameters multivariate TAR models, except number regimes. Support multiple threshold regimes exogenous variables. Automatic variable selection Stochastic Search Variable Selection (SSVS). Flexible innovation distributions, including heavy-tailed skewed alternatives. Standard forecasting rolling-origin forecast evaluation. Model comparison using Deviance Information Criterion (DIC), Watanabe-Akaike Information Criterion (WAIC), log-score (LS), Energy Score (ES), Absolute Percentage Error (APE), related predictive measures. Residual diagnostics based quantile-type residuals. Integration coda package convergence assessment posterior analysis. Parallel model estimation specification search mtar_grid().
